# Closet Tracker for DeepSeek Harness
Your clothing wishlist, in two shapes from one repo:

- **A zero-dependency Bun web app** (`app/`) — paste a product link and
track it: image, name, price

, store, brand, category, price history, outfits,
gaps, palette, PDF export, PWA. Runs normally in a

ny browser.
- **A native DeepSeek Harness plugin** (this package, repo root) — a hanger icon
in the

Harness left sidebar and a full wishlist panel in the main column,
reading the same local data.
## What the plugin gives you

- **The real closet** — reads the same `app/data/items.json` the web app uses, so
items added in eit

her place show up in both.
- **Paste a link to add** — the app scrapes name, image, price, store, br

and and
category; the piece appears in the grid immediately.
- **Stats** — wishlist value, pieces st

ill wanted, bought count, and price drops
since the last check.
- **Filter, search, sort** — status

tabs (All / Wishlist / Bought), category
chips, free-text search, sort by newest, price, name or big

gest drop.
- **Per-piece actions** — check the price now, flip wishlist ↔ bought, remove
(two-step c

onfirm).
- **Sync all** — re-scrapes every tracked link and reports the price drops.
- **Native look

** — theme tokens only, so light and dark follow the Harness;
empty/offline states that say what to

do; quiet auto-retry every 12 s while
the local app is down.

## How it is wired
| Piece | Registration |

| `sidebar.panellist` | `id: closet-tracker`, `order: 30`, hanger icon, localized `label` thunk |
|

`main` | `key: closet-tracker` → the wishlist panel |
| Host route | `prefix /closet-api` on the Har

oset-tracker` → the wishlist panel |
| Host route | `prefix /closet-api` on the Harness web server |

**Why a Host proxy?** The app is a separate local process that sends no CORS
headers, and Harness pl

ugin guidance forbids embedding pages in an iframe. So the
Host half (`index.js`) registers one same

-origin proxy route that the
Client half (`client.js`) calls as `/closet-api/api/...`:

- forwards **only** `/closet-api/api/*` (nothing else is proxied);
- keeps the method, request body,

upstream status and content type;
- **never** sends the Harness session cookie, `Authorization`, or

nnection browser authentication and **fails closed**
(401) when the Connection service is unavailabl
out, and answers a structured `502` JSON when the app is down.

The Client half renders React from the Harness module table, uses only
`--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens,

and registers all visible text through the Harness
locale service.

## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Fix |
| *"Closet Tracker is not reachable at http://localhost:3003"* | Start the app (`cd app && bun run s

tart`). The panel retries by itself every 12 s, or press **Try again**. |
| Sidebar icon missing aft

er install | Reload the Harness page once so the new client module generation loads. |
| Panel shows

data for the wrong app | `baseUrl` in `cordis.patch.yml` must match the app's port. |
| Port alread
y in use | `cd app && make stop` (frees `PORT`, default 3003), or start with another `PORT` and upda

te `baseUrl`. |
| Amazon / Ajio links scrape poorly | Expected — both block bots. The item is added;

fill in details with the app's edit dialog (✏️). |
| `make stop` killed something else | It kills w
hatever listens on the app's `PORT`; check `lsof -nP -iTCP:3003 -sTCP:LISTEN`. |
